bridge.sentence: Jul 2026: Profit €55k but cash +€137k — customers reduced their outstanding balance by €94k, collecting more than was invoiced; €128k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €139k paid to tax authority; €88k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Aug 2026: Profit +€45k but cash €203k — customers owed €255k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €43k more paid to suppliers than newly invoiced; VAT of €88k paid to tax authority; €119k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Sep 2026: Profit +€100k but cash +€307k — customers owed €216k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €115k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €107k paid to tax authority; quarterly tax advance of €40k paid; €435k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Oct 2026 (forecast): Profit +€62k but cash €90k — customers owed €152k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €42k more paid to suppliers than newly invoiced; VAT of €107k paid to tax authority; €127k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Nov 2026 (forecast): Profit +€42k but cash +€149k — customers reduced their outstanding balance by €244k, collecting more than was invoiced; €129k more paid to suppliers than newly invoiced; VAT of €96k paid to tax authority; €68k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Dec 2026 (forecast): Profit €90k but cash +€165k — customers owed €328k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €270k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €125k paid to tax authority; quarterly tax advance of €40k paid; €457k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

assumptions.value: If overdue ≥ expected_delay: as_of + conditional_remaining_delay(d). Else: due_date + expected_delay.
